title: stabilize-slo-enforcer-regional-fallback-hotfix
author: Aisha Rahman
description: Motivation: During a cross-region capacity incident we saw the SLO enforcer aggressively trigger load-shedding and regional circuit-breakers in a tight loop, which interacted poorly with the regional failover path and caused cascading request failures. This PR stabilizes the SLO enforcer evaluation order and smoothing so that regional failover and circuit-breaker transitions do not cause over-shedding. Summary of changes: 1) Reorder enforcer decision path so regional-fallback logic is evaluated before hard-circuit open transitions, preventing transient CB open events from triggering full-region shedding; 2) Add hysteresis and randomized jitter to per-region backoff timers to avoid synchronized retries (smoothing implemented in enforcer/backoff.go); 3) Fix a connection-leak where a background health-check goroutine could hold region handles during failover (services/slo-enforcer/health.go); 4) Expose a feature-flag gate (config: slo.enforcer.stabilize_v2) so we can canary on Dedicated regions; 5) Add a new metric slo_enforcer.backoff_jitter_seconds and two histograms for decision latency to the runtime metrics registry; 6) Add unit tests for ordering logic and an integration chaos test that simulates node loss + failover; 7) Documentation and rollout notes. Checklist: - [x] Reorder logic and unit tests added - [x] Add jitter/hysteresis with configurable knobs - [x] Fix connection leak and add integration test - [x] Add metrics and dashboards (temporary dashboards: observability/dashboards/slo-enforcer-stabilize.json) - [x] Feature-flag gate and canary rollout plan - [x] CI green on re-run Related: ENG-3124, SRE-89, SUP-412. Rollout plan: enable feature-flag in Canary cluster for 2 hours, monitor slo_enforcer.degrade_rate and per-region shed_rate for regressions; if stable, expand to 25% Dedicated traffic then to 100%. If any backoff_jitter_seconds spikes beyond 95th-percentile + threshold, roll back. Notes: This is a behavioral stabilization PR and does not change API surface. The feature flag will default to off in main until canary validation completes.

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover ordering and add hysteresis/jitter to backoff timers to prevent cascade shedding during cross-region incidents. Includes connection-leak fix and new observability metrics. Feature-flagged for canary rollout.
notes_for_oncall: If you see increased shed_rate after rollout, toggle slo.enforcer.stabilize_v2=false for affected regions. Primary metrics: slo_enforcer.degrade_rate, slo_enforcer.shed_rate, slo_enforcer.decision_latency_ms and slo_enforcer.backoff_jitter_seconds. If decision_latency spikes > 500ms retrofit to revert and open incident.
